records.context: Shared paid-drink dialogue, observed from Myrine in Athens. Source825 is a questioning reaction,826 comments on the patron's weakness,827 confirms their name and toasts. Neighbor828 asks about a beautiful object,829 notices an item. No rank or romantic relationship is asserted.
records.localization_note: Natural American English keeps the pondering reaction, confirmation, named patron and friendly toast. Replace awkward Right... with Hmm... and the idiomatic Here's to. A normal punctuation space follows the ellipsis. One logical paragraph; runtime wrapping after the name substitution owns line breaks. Wording is chosen for meaning and voice, not to hide the observed dropped-r defect.
